title: The cause and effect matrix: causes, devices and cells
summary: On any unit or loop in Systems, fill the cause and effect matrix as you would in Excel: type the tags of the causes, add the devices as columns, set each cell with a click or a key, group the causes that vote, and read the narrative E1 writes from them.
roles: Editor; a project role that may edit objects

title: Safety instrumented functions: required SIL, PFD and achieved SIL
summary: Make an interlock a safety instrumented function with its required SIL, give the failure rates and proof test interval, and see its PFD, achieved SIL and hardware fault tolerance.
roles: Editor; a project role that may edit objects

title: Alarms: priority, rationalization and plant states
summary: Add alarms on instruments, rationalize them so E1 proposes their priority, and see which alarms each plant state shows or suppresses.
roles: Editor; a project role that may edit objects

title: Plant states
summary: Name the states the plant runs in (Start-up, Normal operation, Shutdown, Maintenance): each alarm says in which of them it is suppressed.
roles: Editor; a project role that may change project settings

title: The cause and effect matrix and the alarm list as documents
summary: Make the matrix or the alarm list of a unit a document in Revisions, export it to Excel or PDF, and issue it like any document.
roles: Editor; a project role that may create documents

title: The matrix in Excel, and back
summary: Export a unit's cause and effect matrix as the workbook engineers hand over, with its legend, the narratives and a cause-by-cause test sheet; edit it in Excel and import it back, seeing every change before it is made.
roles: Editor; importing needs a project role that may create and edit objects

training.topic: The cause and effect matrix in Excel

title: What changed since the last revision
summary: Compare a unit's cause and effect matrix with a version or revision of its document: the cells and rows that changed since are marked on the matrix.
roles: Anyone who may view the unit
